items.paraphrase: En can reprise a de complement referring to a thing, animal or person.
items.inference: The mites supply the referent in the source; this supports the existing general de-reference pronoun family rather than a new agent-only sense.

items.paraphrase: A passive participle complement may be introduced by par or de.
items.inference: Together with voix and mites, this supports the historical agent reading by them. These modern general pages do not quote or independently verify Voltaire’s precise sentence.

identityDecisions: Qu’auraient is lexical abstract availability under the existing abstract-possession avoir sense, not the published compound-auxiliary qu’aurait sense.
Comment remains the existing how meaning with a lowercase contextual bank; no case-only sense.
Relational pour differs from beneficiary/purpose and from earlier personal-viewpoint pour moi; it targets the existing preposition lemma with final workwide sense reconciliation pending.
